_comment: Material Custom-node bodies, kept out of the authoring script so exactly one copy exists.
Tools/Fluids/author_clearwater_water.py builds the material graph from these, and
Tools/Fluids/clearwater_embed_check.py compiles them the way Unreal will. Editing one
without the other is therefore impossible.
HLSL functions named here are sliced from clearwater_waves.hlsl at the CW_BEGIN_MATH
marker, so the maths also has a single home.

normal._note: The texture pin is named FineNormalMap because Unreal derives the sampler name from the texture PARAMETER (parameter + "Sampler"); the pin name must match so the generated sampler identifier resolves.

optics._note: Texture pin named CausticMap for the same reason as the normal node.
